root_cause: Live CTAs send visitors to /frisse-blik, which opens the scan view. The scan result offers portal and signup only; there is no booking step. Calendly shows one active consultation since 1 September.
fix: Build adds one booking link next to the scan result signup button, behind a uniqueness guard that fails the build if the anchor changes.
prevention_rule: Every money-page result must offer a next step that leads to a booking or a contact route.

live_readback: Calendly bookings count after deploy versus 1 before
